description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the ControlFilter component in the OFBiz web application framework. It uses Mockito for mocking servlet request/response objects and tests various filter behaviors such as path allowances, redirection, error handling, and recursion control.

classes.name: ControlFilterTests
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the behavior of ControlFilter in various scenarios including allowed paths, redirection, error handling, and recursive redirect prevention.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and the ControlFilter instance before each test execution.

methods.name: filterWithExactAllowedPath
methods.description: Tests that a request matching an exact allowed path proceeds through the filter without redirection.

methods.name: filterWithAllowedSubPath
methods.description: Tests that a request with a sub-path of an allowed path proceeds without redirect.

methods.name: filterWithRedirection
methods.description: Tests that a request to a disallowed path results in redirection to the configured redirect path.

methods.name: filterWithURIredirection
methods.description: Tests redirection to an external URL when the redirect path is an absolute URL.

methods.name: bailsOutWithVariousErrorCodes
methods.description: Tests that the filter correctly sends error responses with default and specified error codes.

methods.name: redirectAllAllowed
methods.description: Tests the behavior when 'forceRedirectAll' is enabled and the request matches an allowed path, resulting in a redirect.

methods.name: redirectAllNotAllowed
methods.description: Tests the 'forceRedirectAll' behavior when the request does not match an allowed path, verifying redirection occurs.

methods.name: redirectAllRecursive
methods.description: Tests the recursive redirect prevention mechanism using session attributes to avoid infinite redirects.
